quarterly_data.quarter: Frontken Bursa announcement: Acquisition of Industrial Land and Factory Buildings in Tainan (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Frontken's major subsidiary Ares Green Technology Corporation (AGTC) won a public tender on 15 September 2026 for an industrial property in the Tainan Xinying Industrial Zone, Taiwan: about 16,172.00 m2 of land with seven existing factory buildings of about 12,611.07 m2 floor area, about 950 metres from AGTC's existing P1 facility. Rationale: support the expansion of AGTC's operations and future capacity requirements, providing space for future production lines to meet anticipated market demand, as guided by its customers.
quarterly_data.figure: land ~16,172.00 m2; seven factory buildings, ~12,611.07 m2 floor area
